- A methyl group (3H singlet at 2.12 ppm)
- An aromatic ring with 4 hydrogens showing complex splitting patterns
- The aromatic signals suggest a substituted benzene ring

The pattern of aromatic signals (2H, 1H, 1H) and their coupling patterns suggest an ortho-disubstituted benzene ring. The methyl singlet at 2.12 ppm could be attached to a carbonyl (acetyl group) or directly to the aromatic ring.
